# Vedant Solanki

Portfolio of Vedant Solanki (also known as Ved Solanki), backend architect and technical solution architect with 10+ years of experience.

## Focus
- Python backend systems
- AWS and cloud architecture
- Event-driven systems and automation
- AI integrations and practical product engineering

## AI Skills
- Generative AI and large language models
- Prompt engineering
- Agentic AI, AI agents and multi-agent systems
- Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
- Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM tool use and function calling
- AI security
- AI-assisted software development
- AI workflow automation
- Generative media (image, video, voice)

## Technical Stack
- Backend: Python, Django, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Docker
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud, GitHub Actions
- AI & Agents: Claude API, OpenAI API, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, MCP servers, RAG, Jev, xAI Grok API, Hugging Face, Ollama, Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI (learning)
- AI coding and app building: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Agent Skills, Lovable, Replit Agent, Firebase Studio, Google Stitch; iOS and macOS apps shipped with AI-assisted development
- Agent apps: Grok Bot, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, ChatGPT Agent, Manus
- Automation: n8n
- AI media: Nano Banana, Sora, ElevenLabs
- Research: Perplexity, NotebookLM, ChatGPT, Gemini, Firecrawl
